name: Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun)
notes: Daily domestic flights; 20 km from Dehradun town; 15 km from Rishikesh. Red-painted public buses run to Rishikesh stopping at the airport en route.

name: Pantnagar Airport
notes: About 70 km / 2 hours from Nainital; 30 km south of Haldwani. Very limited scheduled flights.

name: Kathgodam Railway Station
notes: Primary railhead for Kumaon: 35 km from Nainital. Bus station 100 m from the station; buses to Nainital ~₹60 per person; taxis and shared taxis available.

name: Haldwani Bus Hub & Shared-Taxi Stand
notes: Main changeover point for Kumaon hill travel — shared taxis to Pithoragarh and buses onward to Almora/Munsiyari. Prepaid taxi booth at the railway station.

name: Dehradun Railway Station
notes: Railhead for Garhwal. Hill Bus Services Section (at the railway station) runs buses to Mussoorie and Kempty Falls; taxis to Mussoorie ~₹610, shared taxis ~₹100/seat.

name: Yog Nagari Rishikesh Railway Station
notes: Terminus of the Howrah–Rishikesh corridor (Doon Express 13009/13010). Shared taxis to destinations within Uttarakhand leave from Natraj Chowk, 1 km from the Rishikesh bus station.

name: Haridwar Railway Station
notes: Major railhead on the Delhi–Dehradun line; traditional starting point of the Char Dham Yatra. Nearest airport: Dehradun's Jolly Grant, 20 km.

name: Delhi Kashmere Gate ISBT
notes: From ISBT Kashmere Gate (Old Delhi), Deluxe, Volvo, semi-deluxe and ordinary Uttarakhand state (UTC) buses depart hourly for Dehradun.

name: New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS)
notes: Origin of the Dehradun Shatabdi (12017) and Kathgodam Shatabdi (12039) corridors to Uttarakhand.
sourceName: Wikipedia (English) — Dehradun Shatabdi Express; Wikivoyage Kathgodam

name: Old Delhi Junction (DLI)
notes: Origin/stop for the Mussoorie Express (14041, to Dehradun) and the Ranikhet Express (15013, to Kathgodam).

name: Dharchula (Inner Line Permit checkpoint)
notes: Gateway + permit checkpoint for the Adi Kailash / Om Parvat / Kuthi Valley border zone: permits for this route are issued at Dharchula and a medical check-up is conducted there.
sourceSentence: The permits for this route are issued at Dharchula and medical check-up is conducted there.

name: Joshimath Bus Hub
notes: Road head for Badrinath, Valley of Flowers (via Govindghat/Ghangaria) and Auli. Permits for Valley of Flowers are obtainable directly at the check-post in Ghangaria.
sourceSentence: One can directly get permit from the check-post in Ghangaria, no need to apply prior.

name: Natraj Chowk Shared-Taxi Stand (Rishikesh)
notes: Shared taxis to destinations within Uttarakhand leave from Natraj Chowk, 1 km from the Rishikesh bus station.
sourceSentence: Shared taxis to destinations within Uttarakhand leave from Natraj Chowk, 1 km from the Rishikesh bus station.

name: Ramnagar (Corbett gateway)
notes: Gateway town for Jim Corbett National Park; safari permits are issued at the CTR Reception Office in Ramnagar (online booking via corbettonline.uk.gov.in). Only local licensed gypsy vehicles may move inside the park.
sourceSentence: Permits are issued at the CTR Reception Office in Ramnagar.
